{{Quote|Calm down? My brother's murder went unsolved for twenty years, and you expect me to sit across from his murderer and stay calm?|The Alde delegate|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''member''' of [[House Alde]], one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Great Houses]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], attended the [[Alderaan Peace Summit]] in [[3643 BBY]] as the delegate representing her house. Her [[Unidentified Alde delegate's brother|brother]] was murdered twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior, and [[Sidonie Garen]] falsely accused another delegate of the crime.
